name: decision-sparring
description: Stress-tests a technical or business decision against a structured questionnaire (framing, assumptions, alternatives, evidence, motives, consequences, reversibility) and delivers a reasoned verdict with a stated tipping condition, instead of only asking questions. Draws on the Kahneman/Lovallo/Sibony decision quality checklist, Structured Analytic Techniques, ATAM and the one-way/two-way door principle.
